The adopted register is estimated-weight IJ covariance, robust-ordinal global
fit-function SB/PEBA4, and estimated-weight nested profile-law SB/PEBA4.
The recipes are fixed by the misspecification-robust requirement; finite-sample
calibration is pending. Comparators never select a replacement recipe.

How well calibrated are these all-ordinal DWLS components? There is no
calibration answer yet. The corrected thresholds-to-metric theta pair is
available for binary and five-category data, with both fits converged. Full
smoke and pilot remain pending a clarification of the retained threshold-shift
power family; no production run has been launched.

```{r}
path <- file.path('results','dwls-policy','corrected-preflight','availability.csv')
if (!file.exists(path)) stop('Run Rscript run_experiment.R --preflight before rendering.')
x <- read.csv(path)
knitr::kable(x[c('categories','converged_h1','converged_h0','available','df','spectrum_size')],
  col.names=c('Categories','Larger converged','Restricted converged','Available','Restriction df','Spectrum size'))
```

The gate uses a two-factor, twelve-indicator Gaussian-copula population,
400 total observations split equally between identical groups, symmetric
thresholds, and theta parameterization. The amended larger fit constrains
thresholds; the restricted fit adds loading equalities. This tests the
Wu–Estabrook metric step. The previous loadings-to-thresholds-plus-loadings
pair was correctly rejected because it releases response scales/intercepts.
The original preflight is retained unchanged.

The amendment resolves availability but leaves a question for the registered
power design: the threshold-shift family now imposes threshold equality in
both fits. Its rejection rate measures sensitivity of the loading-equality
step under that perturbation, rather than power of a threshold-equality test.
The next decision is whether to retain that family with this interpretation,
or register a separately validated threshold-invariance pair. No pilot data
have been seen and no production CPU-hour estimate is available.

The full prospective 154-cell design is registered in `criteria/dwls_policy.md`.
Tiny original and amended availability, design and metadata CSVs are frozen
to preserve the design correction and package/source provenance. They are not
calibration or timing evidence.

Reproduce with the lane library and one math thread:

```sh
R_LIBS=~/.cache/magmaan-rlib/lane-d OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 \
  nice -n 10 Rscript experiments/decisions/05-dwls-policy-calibration/run_experiment.R \
  --preflight --run-id fresh-corrected-preflight
```

The command checks component availability and saves evidence. `--smoke`, `--pilot` and `--production`
refuse to run while this gate is unresolved.
